strategy.thesis: Climate-tech venture builder that co-founds startups with proven entrepreneurs. Targets '100x100' companies that can reach US$100M in high-margin recurring revenue and abate 100M tons of CO2e/year, aiming to reduce 10% of the global carbon budget by 2035.
